name: B10-0523/2026 (S&D) – Le cas de Dawit Isaak, journaliste suédo-érythréen détenu arbitrairement en Érythrée
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Eritrean-Swedish journalist Dawit Isaak, arbitrarily detained in Eritrea
part_text:
**What this asks for**

The European Parliament is calling for the release of Dawit Isaak, a Swedish-Eritrean journalist and European Union citizen. He was arrested in Eritrea in September 2001 and has been held for 25 years without charge or trial. The Parliament wants Eritrea to free him and other jailed journalists, to show proof they are alive, to stop torture, and to let families and lawyers visit. It also asks European Union countries to push harder for his release and to consider sanctions. This is a statement of position, not a law.

**Key points**

- Nothing changes immediately. The Parliament is urging Eritrea to act and asking European Union bodies to press the case.
- It affects Dawit Isaak, other detained journalists, and their families, who want proof of life and access.
- Next: European Union diplomats raise the case with Eritrea, and the Council may consider targeted sanctions.
